value.rationale: The known regular probability is only one point of the physically motivated shape-deformation question. An all-positive-parameter closed distribution and unique strict maximum show how silhouette complexity changes under both compression and elongation; both degenerations force near-certain quadrilateral shadows. This is a natural full classification of the axial family with a nontrivial sign-changing derivative, not a generic name substitution or isolated recomputation.
